svg.title: codeql-mrva: a real session
svg.desc: A real terminal session with the codeql-mrva scripts, recorded on 2026-11-26. It builds a list of the top 20 Python repositories, keeps the 17 whose CodeQL database is under 100 MB, tests a demo query that finds deprecated datetime.utcnow() and utcfromtimestamp() calls on one database (3 results in stable-diffusion-webui), submits it with gh mrva to 17 repositories, and after 4 minutes 33 seconds gets 11 results in 3 repositories, which mrva_sarif.py turns into a triage table and a hits list.
